sourceFile: 9.1 MSU-L20S15-07 Report test change temperature dry CMG+CPT improve NG not dry glue_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies the primary change; source supports dry temperature 80/85±5°C to 120±5°C with defect improvement.
issues: Primary changed factor is dry temperature, not supplier/lot/line/date.
Baseline and changed conditions are wrongly stated.
Critical before/after total rows are omitted from outcomes.
Measurement outcomes contain parser artifacts and bogus specs.
Supplier and lot details should be subgroup context only.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to dry temperature change from 80/85±5°C to 120±5°C.
Use daily rows as follow-up subgroups by date,line,temp,time,lot.
Use rows 36-37 as main before/after comparison evidence.
Remove invalid measurement-stat outcomes and bogus spec violations.
Summarize outcomes as decap NG and MG/PT separate NG rates before vs after.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but key comparison citations are missing and current citations are misgrouped.
